# Vendored Astro SEO

Copied from `@astrolib/seo@1.0.0-beta.8` by onWidget (MIT):
https://github.com/onwidget/astrolib/tree/main/packages/seo.

The published package's Astro peer range ends at Astro 5. Keeping its component
and tag renderer locally preserves the site's existing metadata behavior while
allowing a supported Astro version. Only SEO prop types and their referenced
types are retained; unrelated structured-data types and unused renderer helpers
are omitted. Formatting follows this repository.

The package declares an MIT license but does not ship a license file. The
adjacent MIT notice attributes its declared author, onWidget.
